rubrics.justification: Generally reasonable description of a blastocyst with caveats about single-frame assessment, but it is somewhat inconsistent on expansion stage and gives tentative ICM/TE comments without strong image support.
Integrates age, embryo grade, endometrium, BMI, ovarian response, unexplained infertility, and sperm motility into prognosis well, though AMH/FSH and some interactions are not deeply explored.
Overall logic is sound, but there are internal inconsistencies such as calling the embryo good quality yet not elite, fluctuating implantation estimates, and mixed comments about transfer strategy.

Mostly consistent with IVF practice: acknowledges morphology limits, supports single embryo transfer, discusses age-related aneuploidy and nuanced PGT-A counseling, though mention of possible double transfer is less guideline-concordant.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle modification, luteal support adherence, and future planning including uterine evaluation and PGT-A discussion, though some recommendations remain somewhat general.
